rv.q: For the second time in the last several months (after a turn as JFK in CityLit's excellent Thirteen Days ), actress Cameron Feagin has taken on an iconic male role and absolutely made it her own.
Anchored by Cameron Feagin's thoroughly evil but ultimately still human performance, I thoroughly enjoyed this production.
Come out to see Feagin as a fantastic Richard III.
For Shakespeare aficionados, Promethean Theatre Ensemble has done a tremendous job in their performance of William Shakespeare’s “Richard III” at Chicago’s Factory Theater.

cn.t: Promethean Theatre Ensemble delivers a powerful, impressive production of Shakespeare's classic, with Cameron Feagin's compelling performance as the scheming Richard earning particular praise for capturing the character's fury and wide emotional range.
